verses.text: For the music director. To the tune "The Deer of the Morning." A psalm of David. My God, my God, why have you left me all alone? Why are you so far from saving me, so far from my cries of pain?
My God, I cry out by day, but you do not answer. I cry out by night, and I cannot be quiet.
But you are holy. You sit on your throne, and Israel praises you.
Our ancestors trusted in you. They trusted you, and you rescued them.
They cried out to you and were saved. They trusted in you and were not disappointed.
But I am a worm, not a man. People insult me and look down on me.
Everyone who sees me makes fun of me. They insult me and shake their heads, saying,
"He trusts in the LORD. Let the LORD rescue him. Let the LORD save him, since he is so pleased with him."
But you brought me safely out of my mother's womb. You made me trust you even when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
I have depended on you since I was born. You have been my God since I came out of my mother's womb.
Do not stay far from me, because trouble is near and there is no one to help.
Many bulls surround me. Strong bulls from Bashan are all around me.
They open their mouths wide against me, like roaring lions tearing their prey.
I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It has melted inside me.
My strength is dried up like a broken piece of pottery. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have laid me down in the dust of death.
Dogs surround me. A gang of evil people closes in on me. They have pierced my hands and my feet.
I can count all my bones. People stare at me and look down on me.
They divide my clothes among them. They throw dice for what I am wearing.
But you, LORD, do not stay far away. You are my strength. Come quickly to help me!
Rescue me from the sword. Save my precious life from the power of the dogs.
Save me from the mouth of the lion! You have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.
I will tell my brothers and sisters about your name. I will praise you among the gathered people.
You who respect the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, honour him! All you descendants of Israel, stand in awe of him!
He has not looked down on or turned away from the suffering of the one who suffers. He has not hidden his face from him. He listened when he cried to him for help.
You are the reason I praise you among the great crowd of people. I will keep my promises in front of those who respect him.
Poor people will eat and be full. Those who look for the LORD will praise him. May your hearts live forever!
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down in front of you.
The kingdom belongs to the LORD. He rules over the nations.
All the rich people of the earth will eat and worship. Everyone who goes down to the dust will bow down to him, those who cannot keep themselves alive.
Future generations will serve him. People will tell their children about the Lord.
They will come and tell people not yet born that he does what is right, because he has done it.
